description: Preview or build a tagged https:// URL by expanding workspace UTM templates (or explicit overrides) with dynamic placeholders such as {network} and {tag} (Studio and Pro). Changes nothing.

account.description: Optional account label to substitute for {account}.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

campaign.description: Optional override for utm_campaign instead of the saved workspace default.

content.description: Optional override for utm_content instead of the saved workspace default.

draftId.description: Optional draft id to substitute for {draftId}.

medium.description: Optional override for utm_medium instead of the saved workspace default.

network.description: Optional network key to substitute for {network}, such as "linkedin" or "instagram".

overwrite.description: Optional override for whether to overwrite existing utm_* parameters already on url.

postId.description: Optional post id to substitute for {postId}.

source.description: Optional override for utm_source instead of the saved workspace default.

tag.description: Optional campaign tag to substitute for {tag}.

term.description: Optional override for utm_term instead of the saved workspace default.

url.description: An https:// destination URL to expand with UTM parameters.

name: utm_apply
title: Build a UTM-tagged URL
